load_hf_config: load a HuggingFace model config with GGUF, remote URL, and model type overrides support
apply_deepseek_ocr_overrides: apply DeepSeek OCR model overrides including architecture and head dimension fixes
set_architectures: set the architectures field on a HuggingFace config object
